source.source_text: Purpose: install only an approved package identity/version via privileged helper; never arbitrary installer command. Input: package_id:string, version?:string, source_profile?:string. Output: resolved approved artifact, precondition, install result and version verification. Contract: L5 privileged; scope mac.priv.package; timeout 600000ms; cap 1MiB; network allowlisted_package_source only; filesystem approved install paths; explicit privileged policy required; non-idempotent but installed-version precheck prevents duplicate work. Phase 5 planned.
